title: chenopodium ambrosioides f. minus
intro: Chenopodium ambrosioides f. minus, commonly known as Mexican tea or Epazote, is a plant species belonging to the family Amaranthaceae. Mexican tea has been traditionally used to treat various health issues due to its numerous health benefits, including the relief of digestive problems, reduction of flatulence, and treatment of menstrual disorders. The therapeutic actions of Mexican tea include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties, which contribute to its effectiveness in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Mexican tea include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions and potential health benefits.
